preconditions.description: The number of rounds played is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.
Each player's name is a string of lower-case Latin letters with a length between 1 and 32 characters.
Each player's score is an integer between -1000 and 1000, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: At least one player has a positive number of points at the end of the game.
preconditions.description: There is at least one player with a positive score at the end of the game.

postconditions.expression: output == any(player for player, score in final_scores.items() if score == max(final_scores.values()))
postconditions.description: The output is the name of the player with the highest score, and it is the first to reach that score.
